title: MZ Need help with Transition20XX Plugin

posts.author: aerogravy
posts.body:
Hello! I've switched to MZ a while back and the MultiTweaks plugin has been wonderful since I'm using 32x32 tiles. I have a problem though. Zoom works well outside of battle but during battle transitions, the map will immediately go back to it's original size. I'm not sure if I'm making any sense but it goes from a zoomed view to what the map would look like if I'm not using the plugin.
I'm using the Transition200X plugin as well (to get that 2k3 feeling) so I've set "Fix Encounter Map Zoom" to false. Maybe it might have something to do with that? I've been losing my mind trying to figure it out on my own but I'm still having this issue. Can anyone help me out? Asking for a friend.
EDIT: Yeah apparently Transition20XX is messing the Zoom part up because it works fine without that plugin. So if anyone knows how to make it NOT mess up with the MultiTweaks plugin, that'd be awesome. Still asking for a friend!

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
I've moved this thread to Plugin Support (from MZ Support). Thank you.
I assume you mean these plugins?
MultiTweaks: general, map, zoom, battle, enemies, audio, options, efficiency, etc.
MultiTweaks Rpg Maker MZ plugin - MultiTweaks: general, map, zoom, battle, enemies, audio, options, efficiency, etc.  Repository, contributions and download at https://github.com/scswinter/MultiTweaks   Description This script allows you to incorporate some improvements in the game engine (as...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
RPG Maker 2000/XP Style Transition Effects (Ver.3.3.1)
It almost perfectly reproduces the transitions and encounter effects from previous rpg makers. Can be used on map, in battle and in menu.    Download Plugin Transition200X.js Ver.3.3.1 MIT License This is a unique modification of Shioinu's PD_Transition_MZ to make it closer to the original...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
If not, please give correct links to the plugins with which you want help.
Also, you can try e.g. turning off all plugins except MultiTweaks, save your project to apply Plugin Manager changes, then playtest. (When testing, choose New Game from the title, or just enable the Game -> Skip Title Screen option from the editor's menu bar...do not continue from an old save.) That will let you know whether it's that plugin specifically, or something else.
